messages:
Miriam: kicking off predeploy prompt-eval for release v3.4.2. running full prompt-suite against summarizer + qa/rlhf-rerank. change window 2026-03-20 14:00-16:00 PST. DeployBot will post results, please ack.

DeployBot: [deploybot] predeploy-eval started for release=v3.4.2
- suites: prompt-suite.v8, safety-checks.v2, regression-smoke.v3
- targets: model=summ-quant-3, reranker=rr-1.2
- canary routing: 5% traffic

Ben: got it. I'll be on-call during the 14:00-16:00 window. ping me for regressions >2% F1 drop.

Dave: seeing early drift on summarizer length normalization on the 1k seed. noise low but coherency metric down ~2.6% vs baseline.

Carla: is that within the eval gate threshold? what's our rollback threshold again? I can page infra if we need to revert.

Eva: gate config: prompt-eval.delta_threshold = 2.0 (%) and prompt-eval.fail_count_limit = 3. This run currently shows 1 test exceeding threshold.

Miriam: thanks. quick triage please: can we bisect to a model variant or try a prompt shim? if prompt-sensitive we might pin to previous model for the rollout.

Dave: quick diff of failure modes points to token truncation behavior in new decoder kernel. small prompt shim fixes synthetic tests.

Ben: can we apply a runtime prompt shim via routing rule for the canary? e.g., a length guard prepend. safest if it's quick.

Carla: ops note: 30m timebox for mitigations. if canary metrics not within gate in 30m, we must either pin or rollback. DeployBot will enforce the policy.

Miriam: decision framework: 1) hotfix prompt shim in canary (preferred), 2) pin traffic to model:summ-quant-2 (safer, more impact), 3) full rollback (last resort).

DeployBot: [deploybot] initiating canary shim rollout -> rule: prepend "TL;DR:" length guard for summarizer requests in canary. applying to 5%.

Dave: shim applied, rerunning prompt-suite now.

DeployBot: [deploybot] prompt-suite.v8 results (canary):
- coherency: -0.8% (passed)
- length-norm: -0.5% (passed)
- factuality: +0.1% (passed)
- safety-checks: all passed
Aggregate delta: -0.3% (within threshold)

Miriam: good. propose extending canary to 15% for another 45m before full rollout. need QA + Eng signoff.

Eva: +1. will rerun a few high-priority user prompts as additional smoke.

Ben: +1 from release engineering. add to release notes: "temporary prompt shim applied to summarizer; kernel fix forthcoming." tagging infra + ml.

Carla: ops ok to extend to 15% within change window. set auto-rollback if delta >2% or errors >1%.

Dave: QA signoff. will monitor and report anomalies. if two consecutive eval runs show regression >1.5% we escalate.

Miriam: action: extend to 15% now, set alerts, update release notes blurb, and create follow-up ticket to revert shim after kernel patch.

DeployBot: [deploybot] canary extended to 15% at 2026-03-20T14:22:10Z. rollback policy set: auto-rollback if aggregate delta >2.0% OR errors >1.0% sustained 5m.

Ben: drafting release notes snippet:
"- v3.4.2: Summarizer update rolled out with temporary prompt shim to address length normalization variance. Monitoring in place; permanent kernel fix forthcoming."

Miriam: any objections to proceeding to full rollforward after 45m of stable canary? reply with :thumbsup: to proceed.

Eva: :thumbsup:
Bernie: :thumbsup: (sg)
Carla: :thumbsup:
Ben: :thumbsup:

Dave: will post final eval summary at 45m. will tag incidents channel if things degrade.

DeployBot: [deploybot] thread closed for actioning. will post final status update at 2026-03-20T15:07:10Z.
